info.name: Developer Assessment Platform - Auth and Phase 5
info.description: Manual workflow collection for Phase 4 authentication and Phase 5 user/recruiter profiles, uploads, RBAC, and recruiter approval. Set unique candidateEmail and recruiterEmail values before each run. Run requests in order. Pause after each registration to read the emailed OTP and set candidateOtp or recruiterOtp. Provision an ADMIN account separately, then set adminEmail/adminPassword. Cloudinary must be configured for successful image uploads.

item.name: 01 - Candidate Auth and Profile
item.description: Run in order. Registration sends an OTP email. Copy it into candidateOtp before running Verify Candidate Email.

exec: pm.test('health responds successfully', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('standard success envelope', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().success).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('candidate registration returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

pm.test('registration is awaiting email verification', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('candidateEmail')); pm.expect(data.emailVerified).to.eql(false); });

item.name: Verify candidate email - enter emailed OTP first

exec: pm.test('email verification succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateAccessToken', data.accessToken);
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateRefreshToken', data.refreshToken);

pm.test('verified user and auth cookies are returned', function () { pm.expect(data.emailVerified).to.eql(true); const cookies = pm.response.headers.all().filter((h) => h.key.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie').map((h) => h.value).join(';'); pm.expect(cookies).to.include('HttpOnly'); });
pm.test('login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateAccessToken', data.accessToken);
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateRefreshToken', data.refreshToken);

pm.test('login sets HTTP-only cookies', function () { const cookies = pm.response.headers.all().filter((h) => h.key.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie').map((h) => h.value).join(';'); pm.expect(cookies).to.include('HttpOnly'); });
pm.test('protected auth test route succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('authenticated identity is present', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('candidateEmail')); });
pm.test('profile request succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;

pm.test('profile contains safe public fields only', function () { pm.expect(data.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('candidateEmail')); pm.expect(data.role).to.eql('CANDIDATE'); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); pm.expect(data).not.to.have.property('refreshTokens'); });

item.name: Update candidate name and attempt protected-field changes

exec: pm.test('profile update succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;

pm.test('only allowed profile field changes', function () { pm.expect(data.name).to.eql('Updated Candidate'); pm.expect(data.role).to.eql('CANDIDATE'); pm.expect(data.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(data.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('candidateEmail')); });
pm.test('wrong current password is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('password changes successfully', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidatePassword', pm.collectionVariables.get('candidateNewPassword'));

pm.test('password response contains no password data', function () { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).not.to.include('passwordHash'); pm.expect(text).not.to.include('refreshToken'); });

item.name: Old refresh token is revoked after password change

exec: pm.test('old refresh token is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('old password is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('new password login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateAccessToken', data.accessToken);
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateRefreshToken', data.refreshToken);
pm.test('refresh succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateAccessToken', data.accessToken);
pm.collectionVariables.set('candidateRefreshToken', data.refreshToken);

item.name: Upload candidate avatar - select a real image file

request.description: Before sending, select a real JPEG, PNG, or WebP file under 5 MB for form-data key avatar. Cloudinary must be configured.

exec: pm.test('avatar upload succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('profile has a Cloudinary avatar URL', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.avatarUrl).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('missing avatar is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: Select a PDF or text file for avatar. Expect 400 and no Cloudinary/DB change.

exec: pm.test('unsupported avatar type is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: Reject executable renamed as avatar image

request.description: Select a harmless non-image test file renamed with a .jpg extension and set its part MIME type to image/jpeg. Expect 400 from signature validation. Do not use a real executable.

exec: pm.test('spoofed image content is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: Select an image larger than 5 MB. Expect 413 and no Cloudinary/DB change.

exec: pm.test('oversized avatar is rejected with 413', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(413); });
pm.test('candidate is forbidden from recruiter endpoint', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('missing token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('malformed bearer token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('logout succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 02 - Recruiter Application and Admin Approval
item.description: A public signup with role RECRUITER is still stored as role CANDIDATE with recruiterStatus PENDING. Verify it, log in an ADMIN, list applications, and approve by the returned UUID.

exec: pm.test('recruiter application signup returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

item.name: Verify recruiter applicant email - enter emailed OTP first

exec: pm.test('applicant email verifies', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
pm.collectionVariables.set('recruiterAccessToken', data.accessToken);
pm.collectionVariables.set('recruiterRefreshToken', data.refreshToken);
pm.test('signup does not directly grant recruiter role', function () { pm.expect(data.recruiterStatus).to.eql('PENDING'); });

item.name: Get applicant own profile before approval

exec: pm.test('applicant can authenticate as candidate', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('role remains candidate and approval is pending', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.role).to.eql('CANDIDATE'); pm.expect(data.recruiterStatus).to.eql('PENDING'); });

item.name: Applicant cannot access recruiter profile before approval

exec: pm.test('pending applicant is forbidden from recruiter route', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Login admin - provision account outside public registration

request.description: Requires a trusted ADMIN account provisioned manually for development. Do not create an admin through public registration.

exec: pm.test('admin login succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', data.accessToken);
pm.test('logged-in account has ADMIN role', function () { pm.expect(data.user.role).to.eql('ADMIN'); });

item.name: Reject pending application list without token

exec: pm.test('unauthenticated admin request returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('candidate is forbidden from admin endpoint', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('admin can list pending applications', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
const application = data.applications.find((item) => item.email === pm.collectionVariables.get('recruiterEmail'));

pm.test('recruiter application appears as pending', function () { pm.expect(application).to.exist; pm.expect(application.role).to.eql('CANDIDATE'); pm.expect(application.recruiterStatus).to.eql('PENDING'); });
if (application) pm.collectionVariables.set('recruiterApplicationUserId', application.id);
pm.test('admin approval succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const data = pm.response.json().data;
pm.test('approval grants role only after admin action', function () { pm.expect(data.role).to.eql('RECRUITER'); pm.expect(data.recruiterStatus).to.eql('APPROVED'); });
pm.test('already-approved application cannot be approved again', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('approved recruiter can access profile', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('profile belongs to authenticated recruiter', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.userId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('recruiterApplicationUserId')); });

item.name: Create or update recruiter company profile

exec: pm.test('company profile upsert succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('company fields persist', function () { const data = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(data.companyName).to.eql('Postman Example Company'); pm.expect(data.companyWebsite).to.eql('https://example.com'); });
pm.test('invalid website is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: Upload company logo - select a real image file

request.description: Select a real JPEG, PNG, or WebP under 5 MB for form-data key logo. Cloudinary must be configured.

exec: pm.test('company logo upload succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('profile has a logo URL', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.companyLogoUrl).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Select a PDF for logo. Expect 400 and existing logo URL unchanged.

exec: pm.test('unsupported logo type is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

request.description: Select an image larger than 5 MB. Expect 413 and existing logo URL unchanged.

exec: pm.test('oversized logo is rejected with 413', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(413); });

item.name: 03 - Manual Edge Cases and Replacement Uploads
item.description: Use the same test accounts after the main folders. The expired-token and soft-delete checks require the documented local setup steps. Upload replacement requests require a different valid image file.

exec: pm.test('too-short profile name returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test('too-short new password returns 400', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: Replace candidate avatar - choose a different image

request.description: Select a different valid image than the first avatar upload. Expect a new URL; check Cloudinary for deletion of the prior public ID.

exec: pm.test('avatar replacement succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('new avatar URL is present', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.avatarUrl).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

item.name: Replace recruiter company logo - choose a different image

request.description: Select a different valid image than the first logo upload. Expect a new URL; check Cloudinary for deletion of the prior public ID.

exec: pm.test('logo replacement succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('new company logo URL is present', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.companyLogoUrl).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: For a local test, temporarily set JWT_ACCESS_EXPIRES_IN=1s, restart, log in, copy candidateAccessToken into expiredAccessToken, wait 2 seconds, then send. Restore the normal expiry afterward.

exec: pm.test('expired access token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

request.description: Copy a valid candidateAccessToken into deletedUserAccessToken. In Prisma Studio set that user's deletedAt to the current time, then send. Expect 401. Restore the test record afterward if needed.

exec: pm.test('soft-deleted user is rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: Cloudinary missing configuration returns controlled error

request.description: Optional configuration test: temporarily blank Cloudinary env vars and restart, then attach a valid image. Expect 503, no secret details in the response, and the existing avatar URL unchanged. Restore configuration afterward.

exec: pm.test('missing Cloudinary configuration returns 503', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(503); });
pm.test('response does not expose Cloudinary credentials', function () { const text = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(text).not.to.include('api_secret'); pm.expect(text).not.to.include('api_key'); });

item.name: 04 - Optional Google Auth
item.description: Only run when Google OAuth is configured. Set googleCredential to a valid Google ID token.

request.description: Skipped unless a valid Google ID token is configured. Expect 200 and auth cookies when enabled.

exec: pm.test('Google auth succeeds when configured', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Google login sets auth cookies', function () { const cookies = pm.response.headers.all().filter((h) => h.key.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie').map((h) => h.value).join(';'); pm.expect(cookies).to.include('HttpOnly'); });
